verdict.rationale: Zulip's source is public in the zulip/zulip GitHub repository, which accepts code contributions. Community users describe it as open-sourced and "100% FOSS" rather than open core. Self-hosters also run the same software as Zulip Cloud. missing for 10: a first-party statement naming the specific open-source license, explicit documentation that the full codebase (server and clients) is covered by that license.
